data.raw_text:
Hinjawadi to Chakan Roads Affected: Pune Grand Tour Traffic Advisory

Traffic restrictions will be enforced in multiple areas of Pimpri-Chinchwad, including Hinjawadi’s IT Park, along with parts of Maval, Chakan, and Paud, due to the ‘Pune Grand Tour – Stage One’ cycling race. Deputy Commissioner of Police Vivek Patil said the diversions are necessary to manage the event safely and to facilitate the uninterrupted movement of riders and support teams.
